 "Beyond Amazing"... 13-Year-Old Youngest Contestant Delivers Moving Performance on 'Our Ballad 2'
 SBS World News 
 Seoul 
 Published 
 2026.10.19 13:51 
 View 
 View Count 
 Enlarge image 
 On SBS's 'Our Ballad 2', the youngest 13-year-old contestant with the emotional depth of an R&B master is set to deliver a touching performance. 
 Aired at 10 p.m. on October 19, the upcoming episode of SBS's 'Our Ballad 2' will feature the special story and stage of the youngest contestant among participants with an average age of 17.9. 
 Traveling back and forth five hours by bus every week with her mother to pursue her dream of music, this contestant chooses Yoonmirae's 'Good Bye Sadness, Hello Happiness' for the mother who supports her. With rich emotion and a husky voice hard to believe for her young age, she instantly captivates the Top-100 Ear evaluation delegation. 
 Listening to the song, Park Kyung-lim empathized with a mother's heart and her eyes welled with tears, while Jung Seung-hwan spared no praise, saying, "She was simply born with it. It's beyond good, it's phenomenal." 
 Meanwhile, regarding this stage, music team member Jung Jae-hyung tried to take the upper hand by saying, "Be quiet, entertainment team," to which entertainment team member Cha Tae-hyun struck back by saying, "Say something that is actually helpful," heating up the studio atmosphere. 
 In addition, a unique contestant who changed genres from 'Show Me The Money' to challenge 'Our Ballad' will appear. Expectations are high on what kind of twist stage this contestant—who elicited cheers from Cha Tae-hyun with an unusual sparkle in their eyes and honest eloquence—will show by transitioning from hip-hop to ballads. 
 'Our Ballad 2', where the passion of contestants with unprecedented soul and twist personalities will unfold, airs at 10 p.m. on Monday, October 19. 
 Reporter Kang Sun-ae 
 (SBS E! News, Reporter Kang Sun-ae)
